domain: Galerkin/pseudospectral T^3, N≤24, 2/3 dealias (NOT continuum PDE)
statement: For all divergence-free Fourier fields on the N³ grid with N≤24, dealiased Galerkin NS (ν=0.1), kinetic energy ≤ 0.5, one has Ω(t) ≤ 73.5 for all t ≥ 0, via Ω ≤ K² E ≤ K²(24) E0 = 73.5 (L-0018). FINITE-DIMENSIONAL only.
clay_implication: None. Finite dealiased Galerkin spectral envelope only; does not address continuum Clay routes.
notes: Envelope extension of C-0003 to N≤24. Stokes floor at T=0.02 is ≈40.824623 (does not threaten M=73.5).
